summary: Phase A NaBaB backend validated end-to-end. 34/34 pytest tests pass covering new pricing (general=0, agent=8, welcome=50, free_chat_daily_limit=100, 5-tier presets 100/300/500/1000/2000), free general chat via Gemini (no credit deduction, free_chat_remaining returned, Bangla responses), Bangladesh-aware persona (BD universities cited), Agent Mode credit consumption (8 credits) and PERMANENT per-conversation lock (backend overrides client mode='general' to 'agent' on locked conversations and deducts 8), 429 on >100/day general messages, 402 on agent with insufficient credits while general still works free when drained, conversation list exposes agent_locked, plus backwards-compat (auth/me, credits/purchase, transactions, admin/decide approve, admin/stats).
critical_code_review_comments: Free chat counter uses today_start ISO string comparison. Works correctly because timestamps are stored as ISO-8601 with timezone — string lex order matches chronological order for UTC ISO strings. Worth a comment in code.

FREE_CHAT_DAILY_LIMIT is enforced by counting user-role messages with mode='general' across ALL conversations for that user — good. However the count is taken BEFORE inserting the new user message, then `today_count - 1` is returned as free_chat_remaining; intended math is (LIMIT - today_count - 1) — verified correct: after sending msg N, remaining = 100-N, so first msg leaves 99 — matches request spec.
Agent-lock enforcement: req.mode is mutated in-place after lock check. Works, but immutable Pydantic style would be cleaner (compute final_mode local var) — minor.
_call_llm forwards full chat history both via LlmChat session_id AND via manual prepend — duplicates token usage (flagged in iteration 1, still present).
No payment_method_id whitelist validation on /credits/purchase (still flagged from iteration 1).
admin/decide approve is still non-atomic (race could double-credit) — recommend findOneAndUpdate({status:'pending'}) (still flagged).

Welcome bonus value (50) is only exercised via pricing endpoint in tests; the actual signup path requires emergent OAuth which isn't reachable in test env. Code review confirms server.py line 271 uses WELCOME_BONUS_CREDITS=50 when inserting a new user — correct.
Gemini model identifier 'gemini-2.5-flash' is accepted by Emergent SDK in this environment — confirmed working (general chat returns non-empty Bangla content).
server.py is now 668 lines — strongly recommend splitting into routers (auth, chat, credits, admin) and a models module before Phase B.
test_credentials: Per-test bootstrapped via mongosh into DB_NAME=test_database (see conftest.py _create_session). One throwaway normal user (1000 credits) + one admin user (5000 credits) per session; cleaned up after.
seed_data_creation: TestFreeChatLimit seeds 100 user/general/today messages with msg_id prefix 'TEST_seed_' to trigger the 429 path, then deletes them after the test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase A behavior locked in. To re-run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v (~60s). LLM calls (general=Gemini 2.5 Flash, agent=Claude Sonnet 4.5) take 3-8s each. If Gemini model id ever stops being recognized, the general chat tests will be the first to fail. Welcome bonus assertion is via pricing endpoint only (OAuth flow not reachable from test env).
